'''V3 Esports''' is a Japanese team. Their sister team is [[V3 New Generation]]. They are owned by '''学校法人神戸学園''' (Kobe High Tech School).

== History ==
The team was formed in May 2017 in Japan.

== Trivia ==
* Known for getting the longest losing streak in pro League of Legends history, with their 39 straight defeats collected from August 2021 to August 2022.
